evidence.title: Civilian Unemployment Rate
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was 0 percentage points; it resolved to 'within recent range'.

evidence.title: The Employment Situation - January 2023
evidence.summary: Directly states the unemployment rate for January 2023 and notes it changed little.

evidence.title: U.S. reports blowout job growth; unemployment lowest since 1969
evidence.summary: Reports the January 2023 unemployment rate as 3.4% and mentions it's not comparable to December's 3.5% due to new population estimates, but the rate itself wasn't impacted by these controls.

evidence.title: U.S. employers added 517,000 jobs last month. It's a surprisingly strong number
evidence.summary: Confirms the unemployment rate fell to 3.4% in January 2023, a level not seen since 1969.

evidence.title: The Employment Situation - January 2023
evidence.summary: States total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 517,000 and the unemployment rate changed little at 3.4 percent. Also mentions the household survey measures labor force status.

evidence.title: Economic News Release
evidence.summary: Explicitly states 'Both the unemployment rate, at 3.4 percent, and the number of unemployed persons, at 5.7 million, changed little in January. The unemployment rate has shown little net movement since early 2022.' It also details the impact of updated population estimates on household survey data.

evidence.title: US adds stunning 517K jobs to start 2023
evidence.summary: Reports the unemployment rate dipped to 3.4% in January, noting it was a 'shockingly strong month' for job additions.

evidence.title: January jobs report: The US economy added a whopping 517,000 jobs last month | CNN Business
evidence.summary: Confirms the unemployment rate fell to 3.4% from 3.5%, reaching a level not seen since May 1969.

evidence.title: Jobs report January 2023: Payrolls increased by 517,000, unemployment rate at 53-year low
evidence.summary: States the unemployment rate fell to 3.4% and was the lowest jobless level since May 1969. Also notes the labor force participation rate edged higher to 62.4%.
